name: AnimateIcons
summary: Free open-source set of 1170 animated SVG icons for React, built on Lucide and Motion, with npm, CLI and MCP installs.
description: Animated icon library for React. 1170 SVG icons in two styles: 669 Lucide-style icons for product interfaces and 501 Huge-style icons for dashboards and rich UIs. Each icon is a drop-in component built on motion/react that animates on hover, focus or imperatively, with configurable size, color and duration. Install the @animateicons/react package, copy icons into your repo with the shadcn CLI or the animateicons CLI, or let an AI agent add them through the MCP server.
contains: 1170 animated SVG icons for React (669 Lucide, 501 Huge)
install paths: npm (@animateicons/react), shadcn CLI, animateicons CLI, MCP server
hover, focus and imperative animation triggers; size, color and duration props
motion/react bundled; per-icon ESM import paths
MIT licensed and free to use
